$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 44 (validate the hook surface on a real host). Written to be un-satisfiable by the work already done: 2a6d001 already makes conformance/hooks.py green, so a criterion that only checked the suite would report complete on the day the issue was filed. What is missing is evidence from a HOST, so every check below targets a results file that does not exist yet and must carry a verdict on prompt 1 -- the failing case the hook was built for. The 'not yet' guard is the fix from 227106e, where grep -q matched a sentence saying the work was unfinished.

criteria.target: ! grep -qiE 'not yet run|not run yet|to be run|pending' docs/research/hook-validation-results.md
